summary: Import on OpenShift requires the latest AAP instance named `aap` in the `aap` namespace with default database names and users: scale down, restore databases, replace encryption secrets and scale up, starting with `oc patch ansibleautomationplatform aap --type merge -p '{"spec":{"idle_aap":true}}'`.
questions: How do I idle AAP on OpenShift?
Requirements for importing AAP into OpenShift

answer_card.title: Idle AAP on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc patch ansibleautomationplatform aap --type merge -p '{"spec":{"idle_aap":true}}'
```
Only the 6 Operator pods stay running. Import needs the instance named `aap` in namespace `aap` with default DB names and users.
